## testing_mode: RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: SC Gap Check section contains a 'Premise to confirm' branch for assumption findings without user-outcome SC mapping, with confirm/revise/accept-risk options
- DD2: SC Gap Check fallback consumes findings whose schema enum is exactly 'assumption' — structural test asserts literal 'assumption' in both emitter and consumer
- DD3: Structural test asserts no severity filter in SC Gap Check assumption flow

## What to Do
Create `tests/skills/test-brainstorm-sc-gap-assumption.sh` with three test functions:

1. `test_sc_gap_check_premise_to_confirm_branch`
   - Assert `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/post-scrutiny-handlers.md` contains "Premise to confirm"
   - Assert it contains "confirm/revise/accept-risk" or all three options as words
   - Assert it contains the word "assumption" in the SC Gap Check section

2. `test_sc_gap_assumption_schema_enum_consistent`
   - Assert `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/prompts/scenario-red-team.md` contains `"assumption"` (as emitter)
   - Assert `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/post-scrutiny-handlers.md` contains `assumption` (as consumer)
   - Assert the same string `assumption` appears in both (schema enum consistency)

3. `test_sc_gap_no_severity_filter_on_assumption`
   - Assert the SC Gap Check section of `post-scrutiny-handlers.md` does NOT contain severity-threshold filtering language
     (grep for absence of patterns like 'severity.*critical\|severity.*high\|if.*severity\|filter.*severity' in the SC Gap Check section)
   - This verifies low/medium assumption findings are NOT excluded

Add .test-index RED markers for each test function:
```
plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/post-scrutiny-handlers.md:tests/skills/test-brainstorm-sc-gap-assumption.sh [test_sc_gap_check_premise_to_confirm_branch],tests/skills/test-brainstorm-sc-gap-assumption.sh [test_sc_gap_assumption_schema_enum_consistent],tests/skills/test-brainstorm-sc-gap-assumption.sh [test_sc_gap_no_severity_filter_on_assumption]
```

## Test Approach
Given: The post-scrutiny-handlers.md file exists at the expected path
When: grep assertions run against the file content
Then: The file contains the canonical phrases for the Premise to confirm branch, schema enum consistency, and absence of severity filtering

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] File `tests/skills/test-brainstorm-sc-gap-assumption.sh` created and executable
  Verify: test -x tests/skills/test-brainstorm-sc-gap-assumption.sh
- [ ] All three test functions present
  Verify: grep -q "test_sc_gap_check_premise_to_confirm_branch" tests/skills/test-brainstorm-sc-gap-assumption.sh && grep -q "test_sc_gap_assumption_schema_enum_consistent" tests/skills/test-brainstorm-sc-gap-assumption.sh && grep -q "test_sc_gap_no_severity_filter_on_assumption" tests/skills/test-brainstorm-sc-gap-assumption.sh
- [ ] Tests FAIL RED (post-scrutiny-handlers.md doesn't yet contain 'Premise to confirm')
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-sc-gap-assumption.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]
- [ ] .test-index RED markers added for all three test functions
  Verify: grep "test_sc_gap_check_premise_to_confirm_branch" .test-index && grep "test_sc_gap_assumption_schema_enum_consistent" .test-index && grep "test_sc_gap_no_severity_filter_on_assumption" .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
